description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 product commercial prompt with attached video evidence from @Voxyz_ai.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3产品广告提示词。

prompt: Create a dynamic product-landing-page UI/UX demo inspired by Nike's digital language, built around the product in Image 1. Use oversized, bold, italicized sans-serif typography and backgrounds that combine speed-driven light streaks with dark carbon fiber or breathable performance-mesh textures. Show a smooth, fast, powerful scroll through the page, plus high-impact hover interactions with scale-ups and color inversion.
